stories.title: Mitti Wonder enters the global clothing market
stories.summary: Mitti Wonder is an emerging clothing brand driven by a vision to create a distinctive identity in the global fashion industry. Founded by Nilkumar Patel, the brand aspires to bring unique fashion experiences to customers while exploring international opportunities through a focus on creativity, style, and quality.

stories.title: AAFT Online launches fashion design diploma
stories.summary: AAFT Online has introduced a one-year Diploma in Fashion Design, offering practical training and industry mentorship. The program aims to prepare students for roles in design, styling, and merchandising as the Indian fashion industry expands into e-commerce, indie labels, and streaming content production.

stories.title: Bhumi Pednekar wears vintage silk sari ensemble
stories.summary: Actress Bhumi Pednekar attended the 2026 Earthshot Prize in Mumbai wearing an outfit by Bodements. The ensemble was crafted from vintage silk saris and archival embroidery. The look was intended to promote sustainability and the preservation of fashion through the repurposing of traditional fabrics.

stories.title: Rakul Preet Singh Wears Assam's Golden Silk: 6 Things To Know About Muga - News18
Designers discuss India's fashion heritage
stories.summary: Designers Raghavendra Rathore and Rahul Mishra spoke at the fourth edition of Harper's Bazaar India LuXperiences. The pair explored how indigenous craftsmanship and cultural traditions continue to shape fashion as a living archive of identity. The event was presented by Emporio Armani and American Express.

stories.title: Sobhita Dhulipala wins Rule Breaker award
stories.summary: Actor Sobhita Dhulipala received the Rule Breaker award at Vogue Forces of Fashion 2026. The recognition celebrates her experimental fashion choices and willingness to challenge conventional style expectations. She accepted the honor wearing a burnt-orange sheer chiffon dress from the label Deme.

stories.title: Indian households historically repurposed textiles
stories.summary: Long before sustainability became a global buzzword, Indian households practiced fabric recycling by turning worn-out saris and dhotis into quilts, rugs, and embroidered items. These creations served as utilitarian objects while preserving family stories and memories through the reuse of existing materials.

stories.title: Jharkhand showcases six GI-tagged handloom products at Bharat Tex 2026 - DD News
Handloom Hackathon 2.0 concludes at IIT Delhi
stories.summary: The Ministry of Textiles and IIT Delhi concluded the Handloom Hackathon 2.0, which featured 280 participants from 100 teams. The event focused on technology-driven solutions for the handloom sector, emphasizing the role of institutional partnerships and sustainability in strengthening India's traditional weaving ecosystem.

stories.title: Iranian women defy strict dress codes
stories.summary: Women in Tehran are increasingly choosing to forgo head coverings and wear tight-fitting clothing in defiance of official dress codes. Conservative forces continue to resist these progressive trends among younger women, leading to recent arrests in the capital as the debate over personal freedom persists.

stories.title: Evanston designer debuts at Paris Fashion Week
stories.summary: Evanston-based designer Leen Gundogdu debuted her KIVANCI label at Paris Fashion Week on October 7. The collection, titled Swan Epoque, was inspired by the movement of swans. Gundogdu described the designs as an attempt to translate the balance between softness and strength into fabric.

stories.title: Legion of Honor hosts Azzedine Alaïa exhibit
stories.summary: The Legion of Honor in San Francisco is hosting a new exhibition featuring the work of fashion designer Azzedine Alaïa. The retrospective highlights the career of the Tunisian-born couturier, who was known for his body-conscious designs and focus on craftsmanship over commercial trends.

stories.title: Azzedine Alaïa’s designs shaped pop culture. A new S.F. show reveals how - San Francisco Chronicle
The Asian-American designer who went from ‘nerd’ to dressing Ariana Grande - South China Morning Post
Exploring legendary designer and muse relationships
stories.summary: A&E Magazine highlights five historical designer-muse partnerships that shaped fashion conventions. The list includes the relationship between Hubert de Givenchy and Audrey Hepburn, which began in 1953. These collaborations are credited with defining memorable moments in style history through enduring creative friendships.

stories.title: Reflections on fashion and remembrance
stories.summary: A recent memorial march at the Cenotaph in Whitehall highlighted the contrast between modern fashion choices and the solemnity of public commemoration. The event honored Jewish servicemen from the First and Second World War, noting the significance of traditional attire in moments of collective silence.

stories.title: Azzedine Alaïa retrospective opens in San Francisco
stories.summary: The Legion of Honor is hosting a major retrospective titled Azzedine Alaïa: Sculpting Fashion. The exhibition examines the work of the Tunisian-born designer, who famously avoided the traditional fashion calendar. Alaïa is remembered for prioritizing rigorous craftsmanship and body-conscious silhouettes over logos and commercial spectacle.

stories.title: MoMA PS1 to host Latinx fashion exhibition
stories.summary: MoMA PS1 will open Malvestir on April 22, an exhibition exploring the intersection of Latin American fashion and contemporary art. The show features 20 designers and artists. The title is a portmanteau combining the prefix for poorly with the Spanish verb for to dress.

stories.title: Paolo Bulgari dies at 89
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, the grandson of the brand's founder, has died in Rome at age 89. His family described him as the greatest jeweller of our time, noting his talent as an entrepreneur and his service as an ambassador for Italian style around the world.

stories.title: LVMH mourns passing of Paolo Bulgari
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, who helped shape the Roman jewellery house, has died at 89. Bernard Arnault, chairman and CEO of LVMH, called him a key architect of the brand's success and a guardian of its Roman heritage. The cause of death was not disclosed.

stories.title: Jewellery house patriarch Paolo Bulgari dies
stories.summary: Paolo Bulgari, who transformed his grandfather's 1884 silverware shop into a global luxury brand, has died. His family announced the passing of the man they called the king of high jewellery, citing his profound humanity and his stature in the industry.

stories.title: Villa Milano marks 150 years
stories.summary: Milanese jeweller Villa Milano is celebrating its 150th anniversary with a 300-page book documenting its family history. The brand, currently led by the fifth generation of the founding family, says its longevity is defined by innovation, creativity and resourcefulness in attracting a niche of local tastemakers.

stories.title: Natural diamond demand shifts in India
stories.summary: The 2025 De Beers India Diamond Acquisition Study reports that India is now the world's second-largest market for natural diamond jewellery, accounting for 12 per cent of global demand. This growth comes as natural stones face competition from cheaper, lab-grown alternatives and traditional gold investments.

stories.title: Durda Jewelry sells out of black bracelets
stories.summary: Durda Jewelry Co. has sold out of its black-finish Square Chain and Wave Cuff bracelets. The brand views the stock depletion as evidence of a shift in men's preferences toward darker, more modern accessories, noting that black versions of its designs were purchased before gold or white gold.

stories.title: Durda Jewelry introduces adjustable rings
stories.summary: Durda Jewelry Co. has launched an adjustable ring line to address common e-commerce sizing frustrations. The brand claims the move removes the need for customers to guess their size or use printable charts, aiming to fix a long-standing pain point in online jewellery shopping.

stories.title: Padmini Kolhapure enters jewellery wholesale
stories.summary: Actress Padmini Kolhapure has launched a fine jewellery brand focused on manufacturing and wholesale. The venture will supply gold and diamond pieces to existing family-run showrooms across India, aiming to combine the trust of local retailers with the recognition built during her film career.

stories.title: The 2,358-diamond necklace worn by Julianne Moore made its debut in Zagreb - Vogue Adria
Janelle James wears Balmain to Abbott Elementary event
stories.summary: Actress Janelle James attended the 100th episode celebration of Abbott Elementary in Los Angeles wearing Balmain Ruby Monogram Slingback Pumps. She paired the black leather footwear with a strapless midi-dress and a gold-toned chain-linked choker for the red carpet appearance.

stories.title: Queen Letizia wears Massimo Dutti in Madrid
stories.summary: Queen Letizia of Spain visited an artistic residency program in Madrid wearing derby loafers from Massimo Dutti. The queen, who frequently wears the Spanish brand for public appearances, paired the shoes with a blazer, a button-down shirt and wide-legged trousers for the event.

stories.title: Air Jordan 4 gets punk-inspired update
stories.summary: Nike is set to release a women's Air Jordan 4 Retro featuring a white leather upper and silver studs on the mudguard. The 2027 release marks a punk rock-inspired update for the sneaker, which has previously featured studded adornments in limited collaborations.

stories.title: Tilda Swinton wears Chanel in Marrakesh
stories.summary: Chanel ambassador Tilda Swinton attended the 23rd Marrakesh International Film Festival wearing a two-toned slingback shoe from the brand. The footwear featured pastel seafoam green and soft pink hues with buckle closures and 2- to 3-inch block heels, reflecting a silhouette launched by Chanel in 2026.

stories.title: Nike updates Air Max Goadome for winter
stories.summary: Nike is releasing a blacked-out version of its ACG Air Max Goadome Low Foam in December. The sneaker features a Foamposite shell in Dark Smoke Gray, serving as a seasonal follow-up to the Green Goblin style introduced by the brand in November.

stories.title: Chanel’s latest controversial footwear: Thigh-high rubber boots that cost a fortune - Firstpost
Nike signs long-term Formula 1 partnership
stories.summary: Nike will become an official Formula 1 partner starting in 2027. The global agreement includes staff uniforms, F1 ACADEMY performance gear and fan apparel. A limited capsule collection will debut at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, with further releases planned for the 2027 season.

stories.title: Wallpaper fashion director shares gift guide
stories.summary: Fashion features director Jack Moss has released a gift guide for the festive season. The list includes 12 items ranging from vintage tees to wooden charms, which Moss describes as an unabashedly personal selection curated from his year of tracking fashion trends and shopping websites.

stories.title: Uniqlo announces Studio Ghibli collection
stories.summary: Uniqlo is launching a Studio Ghibli UT graphic tee collection in January 2027. The nine-piece range, themed Live for Today, My Dear, features illustrations from films including My Neighbor Totoro and Spirited Away, grounded in a shared appreciation for everyday wonder and hand-crafted storytelling.

stories.title: Textiles and apparel exports see 17.5 percent growth
stories.summary: India's textiles and apparel exports rose 17.51 percent in September 2026, according to CITI data. Textile exports increased 19.87 percent to $1.95 billion, while apparel grew 13.68 percent to $1.13 billion. Strong demand for yarn and overseas sourcing interest drove the monthly rebound across the sector.

stories.title: Arvind to deploy 3D weaving technology
stories.summary: Arvind Limited is partnering with US-based unspun to install OneWeave 3D weaving machines at its Ahmedabad facility. The system produces garment forms directly from yarn, bypassing traditional fabric production. Two machines are scheduled for December 2026, with plans for 30 more across India and North America by 2028.

stories.title: Indian exporters seek new markets as US tariffs rise
stories.summary: Indian textile and apparel exporters are targeting British and European buyers following a 10 percent US tariff hike on Indian goods in July. While the US remains the largest market, exporters are testing whether new trade agreements can secure enough orders to maintain production levels and jobs.

stories.title: Laruicci presents international collaboration in China
stories.summary: New York- and Paris-based fashion house Laruicci showcased 25 looks in Shaoxing, China, on November 6. The runway presentation, part of the China to France International Fashion Release Day, aimed to bridge Western design sensibilities with Chinese textile innovation through a collaboration with the China National Textile and Apparel Council.

stories.title: Norrøna and Uluu partner on seaweed fiber
stories.summary: Norwegian outdoor brand Norrøna has partnered with Australian materials company Uluu to develop a seaweed-based fiber for performance apparel. The collaboration aims to integrate marine-derived materials into technical clothing lines.

stories.title: CSIR-CLRI opens technical textile pilot plant
stories.summary: The CSIR-Central Leather Research Institute in Chennai has inaugurated a technical textile pilot plant. The facility features six specialized machines intended to strengthen research and development. The institute also transferred two indigenous technologies to industry partners, focusing on carbon footprint assessment and sustainable leather finishing processes.

stories.title: OfBusiness to expand apparel manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: SME platform OfBusiness plans to invest Rs 200 crore to expand apparel manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh. The company signed an MoU with the state economic development board for a facility expected to create 12,000 jobs. The site will produce woven apparel for domestic and international markets.

stories.title: India seeks funding to boost export competitiveness
stories.summary: India is seeking extensions for RoDTEP and RoSCTL export rebate schemes beyond December 31, with a proposed funding push of Rs 23,000 crore. US-bound shipments under RoSCTL fell 12.8 percent between January and July 2026, contributing to a broader decline in the export segment.

stories.title: Charity shops report decline in donation quality
stories.summary: Charity retail experts report that the influx of low-quality, disposable clothing from fast fashion brands is overwhelming donation centers. The trend has prompted concerns regarding the long-term viability of secondhand retail models as shops struggle to manage the volume of unusable items.

stories.title: Microplastics: fashion’s ‘ticking time bomb’ - report - FashionNetwork France
Sustainable Coastlines Hawaiʻi hosts trashion runway
stories.summary: Sustainable Coastlines Hawaiʻi held a runway event featuring designs made from repurposed materials, including fishing nets, coffee shop receipts, and plant scraps. Six designers participated in the show, which aimed to highlight the intersection of fashion and sustainability through the use of locally sourced waste.

stories.title: Here’s why thrifting and clothing swaps are so incredibly satisfying - The Washington Post
Ireland leads fast-fashion waste ranking
stories.summary: Ireland topped an international fast-fashion waste index compiled by Arka. The ranking combines textile disposal figures with trade data and Google search interest for Shein. The index does not directly measure the total volume of clothing discarded by consumers in the 62 countries assessed.

stories.title: ZucZug opens farm for garment research
stories.summary: Shanghai fashion label ZucZug has opened Agora, a 20-acre farm on the city's outskirts. The B Corp-certified company intends to pair permaculture with garment research and hospitality. The site includes eight tatami rooms for visitors and artists-in-residence to experience the brand's focus on natural cycles.

stories.title: African retailers face competition from Shein and Temu
stories.summary: African retailers are navigating increased competition from Chinese online platforms Shein and Temu. These retailers utilize social media marketing, low prices, and rapid delivery to reach young urban consumers, challenging the traditional store-based shopping model prevalent in many African cities.

stories.title: Alero Ebigbeyi launches clothing brand Héych
stories.summary: Fashion entrepreneur Alero Ebigbeyi has launched the Nigerian clothing brand Héych. The business focuses on domestic manufacturing to produce apparel for the local market. The brand's retail store opened on November 10, with a stated emphasis on garment quality and affordability.

stories.title: Irish fashion brands making strides on the international stage - The Times

stories.title: Fashionoven strengthens position in Lagos luxury market
stories.summary: Fashionoven is strengthening its position in the Lagos luxury retail market. The brand builds its identity around premium fashion, iconic designer labels, and timeless styles for consumers seeking individuality. Founded in 2010 by a team of Nigerian designers, the company continues to develop its presence in the industry.

stories.title: Spinning and textile firms report earnings recovery
stories.summary: Apparel and home textile players benefited from better order visibility and favourable sourcing. The spinning segment saw revenue and EBITDA increase by 42% and 98% respectively in 2QFY26, with margins reaching 16%. High capacity utilization of up to 100% supported the performance across the value chain.

stories.title: Global brands want fewer suppliers. Meet 3 textile stocks winning more business - The Financial Express

stories.title: What if AI were in fact forcing fashion executives to make even more decisions? - FashionNetwork France
Retail editor calls for government support to hire youth
stories.summary: Drapers editor Jill Geoghegan argues that fashion retail can help address the 1 million UK NEETs by offering fulfilling careers. She suggests the industry requires government support to cut red tape and costs, including lower National Insurance contributions for young employees to help align wages with living standards.

stories.title: UK fashion group seeks restoration of export grants
stories.summary: The UK Fashion and Textile Association is urging the government to restore grants for international trade shows. The group cites customs costs and tax hurdles as barriers to EU trade, noting that clothing export volumes to the bloc fell 19 percent between 2023 and 2025. Exports are struggling.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs lowers Gucci sales forecast
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs has revised its fourth-quarter organic sales forecast for Gucci to a 4.3 percent decline. The bank expects Kering's group sales to remain flat at constant exchange rates. While a recovery is projected for 2027, the bank expects the turnaround to take longer than previously anticipated.

stories.title: Daydream AI shopping agent adds virtual try-on
stories.summary: Daydream is an AI fashion shopping service that allows users to describe items or upload inspiration images to find products. The platform stores user preferences and budget in a Style Passport. A new agent feature now includes virtual try-on and allows for shopper-authorized purchases through participating merchants.

stories.title: EVEREVE opens new store in Annapolis
stories.summary: Women’s fashion retailer EVEREVE has opened a 5,167-square-foot location at Annapolis Town Center. The store offers apparel from over 150 brands alongside a private-label collection. The company focuses on providing individual styling assistance to help customers find clothing that fits their personal style.

stories.title: Shein opens four-day popup in Minnesota
stories.summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein has opened its first physical popup store in Maple Grove, Minnesota. The four-day event features clothing, gifts, and accessories. The move brings the online retailer's low-priced inventory to a physical storefront as the company continues to expand its presence in the United States.

stories.title: Shein opens Maple Grove popup as Gen Z leads in-store shopping resurgence - Star Tribune
Malls, theaters offer virtual try-on via ‘Hunger Games’ hologram - Chain Store Age
Gucci Vision Pro show offers immersive access
stories.summary: Gucci has released a recording of its GucciCore fashion show for the Apple Vision Pro. While the immersive format provides a closer view than standard online videos, the experience reportedly misses opportunities to deliver the full sense of luxury expected from the brand. Luxury is hard to simulate.

stories.title: Ganni exits China after four years
stories.summary: Copenhagen-based fashion brand Ganni is closing its Tmall flagship store in China, ending a four-year retail presence in the region. The company cited an adjustment in business strategy for the exit. Customer service channels will remain open for 30 days to handle final orders and after-sales questions.

stories.title: Early Black Friday fashion sales begin
stories.summary: Black Friday 2026 sales have started early, with retailers including Nordstrom, Madewell, and H&M offering discounts. Shopping experts are currently tracking deals on chic pieces intended to elevate outfit rotations. The hunt for inventory is underway, and the season has been rebranded as a professional sport.

stories.title: Indian Startup Funding Surges 826% to $290 Mn as 23 Startups Raise Capital This Week - TechStory
Style Union parent raises $52 million
stories.summary: Nexon Omniverse, the parent company of value fashion retailer Style Union, has raised approximately $52 million in a Series E funding round. The investment was part of a broader week for Indian startups, which saw 23 companies raise a combined $290 million across various growth and early-stage deals.

stories.title: 13-year-old student launches AI platform
stories.summary: A 13-year-old student from Hyderabad has launched KIKA AI, a platform designed to help young creators build projects using multiple AI models. The founder developed the interface after finding existing developer tools too complex. The project has received seed funding from a veteran technology industry leader.

stories.title: VitusCare raises $3 million for dialysis network expansion
stories.summary: Gurugram-based dialysis provider VitusCare raised $3 million in a Series B round led by Liberty Ridge Capital. The company plans to use the funds to expand its centre network, upgrade technology and train staff. It previously secured $2.7 million in April 2024.

stories.title: GIVA secures $100 mn+ funding in a record investment in the new-age jewellery sector - The Retail Jeweller India
Indian startup funding recovers after holiday slump
stories.summary: Venture capital funding in Indian startups reached $255 million across 22 deals for the third week of November. This follows a record low of $26 million the previous week, which was attributed to festival holidays. The ecosystem has noted the return of capital.

stories.title: BOB Capital Markets sets Thangamayil Jewellery target at Rs 5,697
stories.summary: BOB Capital Markets maintains a buy rating on Thangamayil Jewellery, targeting a 44 percent price increase. The brokerage notes the company is shifting focus from sales volume to profit margins after heavy discounting impacted the first half of FY27. Profit is now the priority.

stories.title: JIS Spring 2027 opens registration for Miami trade show
stories.summary: Registration is open for the JIS Spring trade show, scheduled for March 7 to 9 in Miami Beach. The event aims to provide retailers and suppliers with fresh connections and new brands. Organizers describe the location as a gateway to global markets.

stories.title: CMU hosts fashion merchandising and design showcase
stories.summary: Central Michigan University will host a showcase on December 10 for its fashion merchandising and design program. Guests are invited to tour laboratories and view student projects to learn about industry career paths. The event offers an insider look at the creative learning spaces.
